description:
A collection of Active Directory Tools to streamline Active Directory

Active Directory Pro Toolkit is an easy to use Active Directory Tools that makes managing Active Directory fast, easy and efficient. Automate tasks that are consuming your time and resources.
New Features
- Update Users: custom attributes now work in the CSV. Any attribute added under Settings > Custom Attributes can be used as a column, headed with either its display name or the raw LDAP attribute name. Custom columns apply through the same preview and {clear} handling as the built-in ones, and work in both manual and scheduled runs. They are also listed in Supported Columns and included in the downloaded template.
Bug Fixes
- Local Admins Report: scheduled runs now connect to remote computers using the credentials entered on the schedule. The Run As account was only applied to the Active Directory queries, so the calls that read each computer's Administrators group went out as the service's own logon account and usually came back “Access denied”.
- Local Admins Report: the service log now records how many computers failed and why. A scan where every computer was denied still produced one row each, which previously logged as a normal-looking result.
